detail.longDescription: DigitalOcean has launched Insights in public preview: OpenTelemetry observability for cloud infrastructure and AI agents. It traces a single agent turn from model call through each tool invoked. Will native cloud telemetry replace external suites? https://www. developer-tech.com/news/digita locean-launches-insights-to-unify-agent-and-infrastructure-observability/ # DevOps # OpenTelemetry # Observability
